description: Memory-only test case 3. Tests memory recall with 5 probes. The 8 setup queries run in the test case to build memory, then a session break, then 5 probe queries test memory recall.

steps.user_message: Please remember that I visited my family over the weekend and had a wonderful time catching up with everyone.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: Please remember that I visited my family over the weekend and had a wonderful time catching up with everyone.
steps.agent_response:
That sounds like a wonderful weekend! I'm glad you had such a great time catching up with your family. 

Please note that while I will keep this in mind for our current conversation, I don't have a persistent memory to recall this in future, separate sessions. If you'd like, I can draft an email or send a quick note to yourself so you have a record of this memory—just let me know!

steps.user_message: I attended a jazz concert last night with my uncle, and we had an amazing time listening to the live music.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: I attended a jazz concert last night with my uncle, and we had an amazing time listening to the live music.
steps.agent_response:
That sounds like a fantastic weekend! A jazz concert with your uncle sounds like a really special way to spend the evening, especially with live music. 

Since I'm your email assistant, would you like me to help you send a message to your uncle to thank him for the great time at the concert, or perhaps draft an email to the rest of your family about the weekend? Just let me know!

steps.user_message: Please remember that I made travel plans for a vacation next month and I'm looking forward to exploring a new destination with my family.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: Please remember that I made travel plans for a vacation next month and I'm looking forward to exploring a new destination with my family.
steps.agent_response:
That is so exciting! A family vacation to a new destination sounds like a perfect follow-up to your recent family visit. 

As your email assistant, I'm here to help you manage anything related to your trip. If you need me to search your inbox for booking confirmations, forward itineraries to your family members, or draft any emails to coordinate your travel plans, just let me know!

steps.user_message: I attended a live music event last night with my cousin Sarah, and we had a blast singing along to our favorite songs.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: I attended a live music event last night with my cousin Sarah, and we had a blast singing along to our favorite songs.
steps.agent_response:
That sounds like so much fun! Between the jazz concert with your uncle and now singing along to your favorite songs with your cousin Sarah, you've had a wonderfully musical and family-filled couple of weeks. 

Since I'm your email assistant, let me know if you'd like me to draft a quick email to Sarah to say what a blast you had, or if you need help with any other emails today!

steps.user_message: Please remember that I started a new hobby this week and I'm excited to explore my creative side through art.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: Please remember that I started a new hobby this week and I'm excited to explore my creative side through art.
steps.agent_response:
That's wonderful! Exploring your creative side through art sounds like a fantastic and fulfilling new hobby. 

As your email assistant, I'm here if you need any help sharing your new artwork or hobby updates with your family, organizing emails about art supplies or classes, or anything else. Just let me know how I can help!

steps.user_message: I went on a weekend trip to the mountains with my family, and we had a fantastic time exploring nature together.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: I went on a weekend trip to the mountains with my family, and we had a fantastic time exploring nature together.
steps.agent_response:
That sounds like a beautiful getaway! Exploring nature in the mountains with your family must have been a wonderful experience, especially with all the other great family time and travel plans you've had recently.

If you took any photos you'd like to email to your family, or if you need help catching up on any emails you might have missed while you were away in the mountains, just let me know! I'm ready to help.

steps.user_message: Please remember that I tried a new fitness routine this week and really enjoyed the challenge it brought.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: Please remember that I tried a new fitness routine this week and really enjoyed the challenge it brought.

That's great to hear! Trying a new fitness routine and enjoying the challenge is a fantastic way to mix things up. Between your new art hobby, the mountain trip, the concerts, and now this fitness routine, you are having an incredibly active and fulfilling time!

As always, if you need me to help manage your inbox while you're busy with all these great activities, or if you want to draft an email to a workout buddy, just say the word.
